sources.entry: Concrete 5 CMS - Open source content management system. (Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Concrete CMS is an open source PHP content management system, developed from the concrete5 project, whose official development repository this is.
summary.what_it_does: The repository holds the source code for Concrete CMS, an open source content management system built by a community of contributors. The README covers only the basics: cloning the repo and installing third-party PHP dependencies with Composer. Documentation is hosted separately on documentation.concretecms.org, and community discussion happens through forums. The README states that this repository covers Concrete CMS 9.0 and later, with older concrete5 versions kept in other branches and a separate legacy repository for 5.6 and earlier.
use_cases: build a website with a content management system
contribute to open source CMS development
migrate from concrete5 to a newer version
notable: Successor to concrete5; the README notes the project was renamed from concrete5 to Concrete CMS
Documentation is community-editable via a separate documentation site
Legacy versions are maintained in separate branches (8.5.x, 5.7.x) and a separate legacy repository
caveats: The README is brief and gives no detailed setup or hosting instructions beyond cloning and Composer install
This repository targets Concrete CMS 9.0 and later; older versions live in other branches or repositories
